claims.claim: AUTHOR_REMEDIATION admits a final-only REMEDIATION contract through the existing Issue/Runtime ingress without serialized audit or hash support.

Admission reconstructs canonical TASK, RUN, RESULT, EVIDENCE, REVIEW and correction ancestry, including repaired PRIMARY and REMEDIATION sources, and validates the selected finding, action, scope and verification contract.

New admission rejects malformed contracts, unsupported authority fields, mismatched sources, unauthorized scope or verification commands, and noncurrent findings before publishing a correction ref or creating any RUN.

Subject-specific bindings are rechecked before metadata commit, local ref CAS and push. Destination writes use expected-missing CAS; identical family-contract replay preserves the original immutable commit without mutation.

An older clean checkout missing unrelated TASK files remains usable. Consumed TASK bytes, executable cleanliness, canonical ancestry, transport identity and exact fetched sources remain authenticated admission requirements.

Final-only Issue delivery preserves existing carrier checks and separate Human A3 approval and delegation. Remediation authoring emits no execution or publication wakeup and leaves the independent TASK, REPAIR, Review and Publisher paths intact.

Legacy remediation audit handoffs are inert compatibility data. All three permitted normative documents describe direct final-contract admission while retaining V1 Brain semantic audit discipline and historical migration assertions.

Deterministic positive and adversarial tests cover direct admission, currentness, collisions, checkout trust, historical lineage and carrier boundaries. Changes are confined to the six permitted files and add no lifecycle database, router, Executor selector or automatic correction path.
